co_turkey_rocks.name: Turkey Rocks
co_turkey_rocks.note: Sources call it a south-facing, year-round crack venue good in winter; no source names months.

nm_las_conchas.name: Las Conchas
nm_las_conchas.note: Main crags summer (high elevation), sun walls winter; sources split and name no months.

or_mt_hood_national_forest.name: Mt. Hood National Forest
or_mt_hood_national_forest.note: MP says crags limited by snow/road closure Nov-Apr (implies about May-Oct) but no second source names months.

tx_east_mountain.name: East Mountain
tx_east_mountain.note: Reviewer: Hueco Tanks window as written for North Mountain (round 1, high). Hueco climbing season mid-Nov to mid-Apr (peak Jan-Feb), heat unworkable after April; sources speak for the whole Hueco park.

wv_summersville_lake_main.name: Summersville Lake (main)
wv_summersville_lake_main.note: WV tourism names late Apr-mid Jun and mid Sep-early Nov; WVU says spring through fall. Lake level limits cliff-base access in summer; fall draw-down opens more.

md_cumberland_narrows_aka_lover_s_leap.name: Cumberland Narrows aka Lover's Leap
md_cumberland_narrows_aka_lover_s_leap.note: Only the Feb 15-Jul 31 falcon closure and 'pleasant most of the year, hot in summer'; no source names a season.

or_terra_nova.name: Terra Nova
or_terra_nova.note: Nearby crags tagged spring-fall in words only; no months found.

oh_mrg_southeast_aka_darkside.name: MRG Southeast (aka Darkside)
oh_mrg_southeast_aka_darkside.note: Guides say spring through fall in words only; no months named.

wi_east_bluff_03_west_of_the_quarry.name: East Bluff 03 - West of the Quarry
wi_east_bluff_03_west_of_the_quarry.note: KAYA: Sep-Nov prime, Mar-Jun also good, summer hot/humid, winter off-season; another guide says spring and fall. Sources speak for all of Devil's Lake.

az_paradise_forks.name: Paradise Forks
az_paradise_forks.note: SummitPost gives Feb-Nov with snow risk Feb-Apr and late Oct-Nov; MP says spring/fall prime in words only; not firm enough.

bc_harrison_bluffs.name: Harrison Bluffs
bc_harrison_bluffs.note: HELD by reviewer: second source is a news mention, not a season. Squamish Climbing Magazine: best roughly March-November, workable on sunny winter days; local news treats summer as in season. Second source is weak.

co_morrison_evergreen_littleton.name: Morrison/Evergreen/Littleton
co_morrison_evergreen_littleton.note: Only generic travel pages with differing months (Mar-May/Sep-Nov vs Apr-Jun/Sep-Oct); no climbing source.

ca_mammoth_lakes_area.name: Mammoth Lakes Area
ca_mammoth_lakes_area.note: MP: late Apr/May into Nov depending on snow; other guide: late spring-early fall, May-Oct. Shared window May-Oct; low-elevation Hwy 395 spots climb year-round.

ny_b_chapel_pond_pass.name: Chapel Pond Pass
ny_b_chapel_pond_pass.note: No source names rock months; only falcon closures and a winter ice season.

tn_front_area.name: Front Area
tn_front_area.note: Reviewer: Stone Fort window already on Stone Fort Bouldering (area-page batch 2). Guide: best Nov-Mar, climbable early Sep-late May; another says Oct-Apr; summer hot/humid. Shared window Nov-Mar. Sources speak for all of Stone Fort.

va_prospectors.name: Prospectors
va_prospectors.note: Sources say spring/fall (and fall/late winter/early spring) in words only; no months.

az_central_arizona.name: Central Arizona
az_central_arizona.note: Region spans low desert (winter) and high Prescott (summer); no months named and no single season fits.

co_black_wave_boulder_area.name: Black Wave Boulder Area
co_black_wave_boulder_area.note: Only 'spring and fall' for nearby Unaweep in words; no months for Nine Mile.

co_cathedral_spires_area.name: Cathedral Spires Area
co_cathedral_spires_area.note: Raptor closure Mar 1-Jul 31 and 'fall and winter destination' in words; no month-naming season source.

tn_lilly_boulders.name: Lilly Boulders
tn_lilly_boulders.note: Gripped: all seasons workable, fall and spring best; travel site names Apr-May and Oct-Nov. Sources speak for the whole Obed; shaded boulders stay cooler in summer.
